critical_code_review_comments: fnf-calculator.tsx (324 lines) — well under 700-line limit, uses <Text> + StyleSheet.create + testIDs on all key controls (fnf-emp-search, fnf-compute, fnf-save, fnf-pdf, fnf-pay-save). No React Native red-screen or design issues.

fnf-calculator.tsx:99-102 — reopen uses window.prompt on web (Platform.OS==='web') which works but is not available on native; native path currently sends empty reason. Consider adding an Alert.prompt fallback for iOS or a modal input for Android for cross-platform parity.

fnf-calculator.tsx:279 — the 'PDF' button in the settlement row uses get_by_text 'PDF' which collides with 'Register PDF'; UI works because CTA order gives per-row PDF first. Consider adding testID 'fnf-row-pdf-{settlement_id}' for robust automation.

fnf-calculator.tsx: no explicit KeyboardAvoidingView — acceptable for web preview but on native small screens the many numeric inputs (13 fields) may be occluded by keyboard. Recommend wrapping ScrollView content in KeyboardAvoidingView (Platform.select) for a11y.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 732 F&F Settlement Lifecycle UI is stable. Login flow (unchanged from iter 731): password-login → swap otp_hash in db.twofa_pending → /api/auth/2fa/verify → session_token → inject as localStorage.llc_session_token before navigating to /fnf-calculator. CompanyPicker on this screen uses testID='firm-picker' (matched via [data-testid="firm-picker"]) — clicking it opens a modal, then get_by_text('Kankani Enterprises').last selects the option. All 13 form inputs are indexed in DOM order: [0]=emp-search, [1]=exit-date (placeholder 'YYYY-MM-DD'), [2]=leave-days, [3]=bonus, [4]=notice-recovery, [5]=other-earn, [6]=other-ded, [7]=notice-required, [8]=notice-served, [9]=pf, [10]=esic, [11]=pt, [12]=tds. Reopen uses window.prompt on web — Playwright must register a dialog handler BEFORE clicking the button: page.once('dialog', lambda d: d.accept('reason')). Register buttons trigger native download events (blob url). Cleanup collections: fnf_settlements + fnf_audit filtered by company_id.
